gates.reason: Release evidence must come from a test split.

Known source-family identifiers and external independence evidence are required.
At least 300 distinct human source families are required.
At least 100 distinct pure-AI source families are required.

AI row recall and all-variants-correct family recall must be >= 80%, counting abstentions as misses.
Conclusive paragraph coverage must be >= 60%.
Each identified unseen generator requires >= 100 known AI source families and >= 80% row and all-variants-correct family recall, plus external evidence and complete generator metadata.

resources.timing_scope: Sum of recorded forward-pass times; excludes loading/tokenization and repeats batch time for batches larger than one. This experiment used CLI batch size one.

limitations: HC3 is Wikipedia QA, not English student writing.
AIDE has only three AI essays and unknown author/generator identities.
Model pretraining overlap, author independence and near-duplicate independence are unverified.
One excerpt per document; clipped excerpts are not sentence localization evidence.
Raw scores and selected thresholds are not calibrated authorship probabilities.
Fixed half threshold is a diagnostic convention, not the upstream MAGE decision rule.
MAGE may have seen HC3 or other benchmark text during training; no independent held-out claim for MAGE.
MAGE raw-text preprocessing and a 512-token cap differ from its upstream deployment recipe.
Neither model is installed as a user-facing authorship decision service.
